newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh sells 1.25 bln taka 3-year T&T bond.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh sells 1.25 bln taka 3-year T&T bond.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, said 1.25 billion taka worth of three-year T&T (telephone and telegraph) treasury bonds were sold at an annual 8.0 percent yield in an auction on Wednesday.
The previous annual yield for T&T bonds was 10 percent.

The bank said in a statement on Thursday that there were 10 bids for a total amount of 1.68 billion taka but nine of them were accepted for 1.25 billion taka. The weighted average price of the accepted bids was 77.64 taka per 100 taka against 76.92 taka previously.
This was the fourth auction held by the central bank for the state-owned Telephone and Telegraph Board, which is mobilising funds for expansion programme and installation of digital phone lines.
